name: Hyper Dimension X Convegence City - Chapter 1
source:
What happens when you build an interdimensional gateway in the heart of a tourist city?

You get an unmissable holiday hotspot for multiversal travellers!

Fan favourite characters from, anime, manga, games, cartoons, and more can appear in Convergence City!

Take on the role of a young adventure tasked with satisfying each new arrival! Explore the city, complete quests, and unlock explicit Ero scenes!

Each chapter will add new characters, locations, storylines and quests!
translation:
当你在旅游城市的中心建造一个跨维度网关时会发生什么？

你将获得多元旅行者不可错过的度假热点！

粉丝最喜欢的动画、漫画、游戏、卡通等角色都可以出现在融合城市！

扮演年轻冒险家的角色，任务是满足每一位新来者的需求！探索城市，完成任务，并解锁露骨的色情场景！

每章都会添加新的角色、地点、故事情节和任务！
